title: Limited genomic predictability of complex trait evolution despite genotype-phenotype stability
title_zh: 尽管基因型-表型关系稳定，复杂性状进化的基因组可预测性有限
abstract: Whether genomic data can be used to effectively predict adaptation in natural populations is unknown. Here, we tested the efficacy of genomic prediction of complex trait evolution by monitoring genome-wide allele frequencies and pigmentation variation in genetically diverse populations of Drosophila melanogaster during evolution in both field mesocosms and a controlled, lab-based setting. At two points during trait evolution, we produced a high-powered, well-resolved genotype-phenotype map that exhibited marked stability across independent populations. Although we were able to use this map to correctly infer the direction of pigmentation evolution in both the lab and field settings, the particular loci responding to selection were largely unpredictable based on the direction of trait evolution itself. Our results hold implications for the promise, and limitations, of genomic prediction.
abstract_zh: 基因组数据是否能有效预测自然种群的适应性进化尚不清楚。在此，我们通过监测野外中生态系统和受控的实验室环境中遗传多样性的果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）种群在进化过程中的全基因组等位基因频率与色素变异，检验了复杂性状进化基因组预测的效力。在性状进化的两个时间点，我们构建了一张功效高、分辨率好的基因型-表型图谱，该图谱在独立种群间表现出显著稳定性。尽管我们能够利用该图谱正确推断实验室和野外环境中色素进化的方向，但响应选择的特定位点在很大程度上无法仅根据性状进化方向来预测。我们的结果对基因组预测的前景及其局限性具有重要意义。
